g.text: The hierarchical sparse indexer: one full scan, then bounded scans over a shared pool
Layer 20 (Full): scores all visible positions, keeps its own top 512, and builds the pool
green: this layer's own top-512. boxed: blocks whose max score is among the top 2,048 -> the candidate pool, 2,048 x 8 = 16,384 positions.
Layers 24, 28, 32, 36 (Reindex): score only the pool, pick their own top 512 inside it
blue: the pool (scored). green: a Reindex layer's own top-512 within it. grey: never scored by this layer.
per-query cost of these layers: constant in context length. Layer 20's scan is still linear.
Reuse layers (21 to 23, 25 to 27, ...): no scoring at all; take the latest top-512 as is
